defect_observations.note: The 159.1 reader_evidence lists only independent-random-variables.tex (body and annex) and the two drivers. It omits handbook/parts/p15/conditioning-independence-and-information-w02b-p15-006.tex and its annex. That file carries the 159.1 section heading (line 54) and is the only place on the route that supplies Durrett's unrestricted infinite-collection definition (p. 44). def:p15-general-independence by itself restricts I to finite or countably infinite index sets. The C001 and C002 verdicts depend on that file.
All 16 ED26-P15-CH-independent-random-variables components are keyed to both 159.1 and 159.2. Accounting should not credit the same treatment twice.
The unit destination.lookup records final_subject_task_cases_pending=true. None of the 16 components owns that obligation, so it was not assessed here.

The countable-value criterion is proved for maps into countable S_i with the power set. Durrett Exercise 2.1.2 is about real random variables with countable range. The step {X_i in B} = {X_i in B intersect S_i} is not written, though countable sets are Borel and the step is immediate from the definitions. Verdict not affected.

The m-digit binary representation bijection is justified in one sentence (remainder and quotient by two, then induction). This is elementary arithmetic and the probabilistic argument is written in full. Verdict not affected.

This scope record was not opened, per the audit rules. 'Identified source variants' were checked directly against the held Durrett Version 5 PDF at book pp. 43-57. Every source attribution in the body and annex matched the cited result numbers and pages.
